title: West Way, Petts Wood, Orpington BR5, 4 bed semi-detached house for sale, £1,050,000 - Zoopla

knownGaps.why: Genuine limitation, same shape as redfin-listing. The page spans £561 (0.91 ZEC) to £1,100,000 (1,791 ZEC), three and a half orders of magnitude. UK comma grouping reads correctly. The visible break is the asking price at 1,710 ZEC beside a £375,000 comparable at 610.6 ZEC: the per-amount significant-figure cap drops a decimal at the 1,000 ZEC line, and both would read fine at zero decimals — the digitalocean-pricing defect surfacing inside a page whose span is genuinely too wide for one grid either way.
